culture-cycles.note: Holidays treated like Sundays under the cantonal rest-day laws (SECO table). The 1 August national day is the only federal holiday. Holidays on a Sunday are not moved. This canton has local exceptions: the SECO annex lists different sets by district or by mainly Catholic or Reformed municipality, so check the municipality. St Stephen's Day is not kept when Christmas falls on a Monday or Friday (SECO annex).

laws.rule: Appenzell Ausserrhoden's Sunday-trading Act (Gesetz über den Sonntagsverkauf, art. 1): all shops stay closed on Sundays and on officially recognised public holidays, unless the commune grants a permit. Communes may name at most four Sundays a year when shops may open and staff may be employed without a permit; Easter Sunday, Whit Sunday, 1 August and the holidays that are treated as Sundays are excluded. A breach is a fine (art. 4; the amount is not stated).
laws.heading: Gesetz über den Sonntagsverkauf, bGS 822.31, arts 1 and 4; current version in force from 1 January 2016, read 11 November 2026

laws.rule: The cantonal criminal law (Gesetz über das kantonale Strafrecht, arts 11 and 18): a person who bothers someone by insistent begging, or who sends out children or dependants to beg, is fined. So is a person who wilfully disturbs the night quiet by noise, or who grossly disturbs the quiet on Sundays and public holidays. The Act does not state the amounts.
